besluite.fout: 'hulle' in 'vir hulle vleis' can point to the farmers or the cattle, in a paragraph already full of 'hulle'.
besluite.rede: 'die vleis' removes the ambiguous pronoun without changing who slaughtered what or why.
'n gebruik van gemeenskappe' is natural Afrikaans; 'by' only reads differently, so this is a lateral move.
'Ons weet nie seker of ... nie' is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader; the proposal is merely different.
